sections.title: Shipping & delivery policy
sections.excerpt: When a carrier reports a delay, share the latest available delivery estimate. If the estimate does not meet the customer’s needs, ask a support specialist to review the available options.

sections.title: Shipping & delivery policy
sections.excerpt: International delivery dates are estimates. Customs processing can extend delivery time; the carrier will notify the recipient if additional information is required.

sections.title: Returns & exchanges
sections.excerpt: Faulty items reported within 30 days of delivery can be reviewed for a refund or replacement. Confirm the customer’s preference before creating a return.
